summary.text: Jason Lorang is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Neal Miller; he won the June 2, 2026 Republican primary over Kevin Leatherbarrow.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as educator and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jason Lorang graduated from Cascade High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a fourth-generation Montanan, business owner and early childhood educator, and a retired wrestling coach of 23 years.
In the survey, Lorang listed three key messages: lower taxes and responsible, small government; strong families and a strong workforce; and safer communities.
He named public safety and early childhood as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
